Class HoldingMovement

java.lang.Object
app.order.execution.HoldingMovement
@Entity public class HoldingMovement extends Object
One append-only position change caused by a fill (BR-09/14/15). holdings.quantity is cached from and must reconcile against this ledger — never write the cached quantity without also inserting the matching row here in the same transaction.
